environment.scope: Repository-only / DARK. Corrects the ADR-0107 production-efficacy defect proven by preflight GFX-DASHBOARD-ESTABLISHED-RECOVERY-POSITIVE-PREFLIGHT-111: the established monitoring-recovery eligibility predicate (recovery_eligibility.established_account_recovery_eligible) and the liveness candidate query used trading_account.is_active=True as a gate, but is_active is an EXECUTION/trading-authority control and every production LIVE monitoring account (incl. #50, the motivating case) is intentionally is_active=False, so the feature as first shipped could recover NONE of the live monitoring cohort. This change removes is_active as a monitoring-recovery gate (it is left untouched as an execution gate everywhere), replaces it with an explicit hosted-monitoring-subject gate (readiness_provider == PERSISTENT_WORKSPACE, the authoritative monitoring model's own marker) and adds a fail-closed Copy Trading master/follower exclusion. Both recovery flags remain default-OFF; LIVE recovery stays separately gated behind HOSTED_LIVE_RECOVERY_ENABLED. No is_active is set, no order path is bypassed, no Copy Trading authorization check is changed, no credential/snapshot/host action. NO production or host mutation, NO deploy, NO migration.

Enabling the recovery flags makes an is_active=False DEMO account recoverable with the established flag only; a LIVE account additionally requires HOSTED_LIVE_RECOVERY_ENABLED (live_recovery_disabled otherwise).
is_active=False still blocks every execution/trading path (execution.readiness returns R_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE); recovery never sets or bypasses is_active and never changes a Copy Trading authorization.

actual_results: backend/hosted_workspace/recovery_eligibility.py: gate-1 is_active short-circuit REMOVED (RC_DISABLED retired from the predicate, retained only for vocabulary stability). NEW gate 3b (monitoring enrolment): the account must be a hosted per-tenant monitoring subject per the AUTHORITATIVE model — readiness_provider == PERSISTENT_WORKSPACE OR a HostedMt5Workspace row exists (reason not_monitored otherwise). This disjunction is byte-identical to execution.monitoring_enrolment._build_contexts' own hosted rule, so a lagging readiness_provider never false-negatives a monitored account (see the adversarial-review fix below). NEW gate 4c (Copy Trading exclusion): import-local read of trade_copier.CopierMaster(trading_account)/CopierFollower(follower_account) ONLY to exclude (copier_participant); any read error fails closed (copier_check_unavailable). Docstrings updated to state is_active is an execution control not consulted here, and that copier registries are read only to exclude, never to grant.

backend/hosted_workspace/liveness_recovery.py: the established candidate query dropped .filter(trading_account__is_active=True) (now disconnected_at__isnull=True only, still excluding armed + reserved); the demo-only pre-filter when LIVE recovery is OFF is unchanged. The locked _claim_established_attempt re-checks the SAME corrected predicate under select_for_update (inherits the new gates). The armed liveness pass, bounds, cooldown, observe gate and alert logic are unchanged.

backend/hosted_workspace/tests_established_recovery.py: two defect-encoding tests repurposed to the corrected behaviour (test_disabled_account_is_eligible_for_monitoring_recovery; test_disabled_account_is_recovered_as_monitoring_subject) and the #50 fixture corrected to the REAL production shape (is_active=False). NEW Packet112EligibilitySeparationTests (13 cases): copier master/follower exclusion + all-flags-on non-relaunch + copier_check_unavailable fail-closed; non-hosted not_monitored; is_active=False DEMO recovers with established flag only; inert with flag off; LIVE needs both flags / recovers with both; is_active=False still blocks execution readiness (R_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE); recovery never modifies is_active; locked claim recheck excludes a now-copier account; two eligible accounts each relaunched once with no cross-substitution.

Local verification (PostgreSQL): tests_established_recovery 53/53; recovery+observation+enrolment+account-policy cluster 178/178; manage.py check clean; makemigrations --check reports 'No changes detected' for hosted_workspace/execution/trade_copier/analytics (migration-free); secret grep over the diff: no findings.

docs/architecture/ADR-0107 amended with an explicit ELIGIBILITY-FIX-112 Addendum (is_active is execution authority, not monitoring recovery; monitoring recovery grants no trading authority; hosted-monitoring-subject + established identity govern; Copy Trading excluded; LIVE separately gated default-OFF) and the two superseded inline statements annotated. docs/operations/hosted-workspace/ESTABLISHED_MONITORING_RECOVERY_ACCEPTANCE.md added (corrected contract table + bounded Sponsor-gated positive-acceptance procedure with human flat-confirmation, deliberate single-terminal stop, immediate return-to-OFF, and the standing prohibition on fabricated snapshots / broker actions). This evidence manifest added.

Independent adversarial review (6 reviewers, one per vector: accidental trading-authority broadening; is_active=False leaking into execution; Copy Trading inclusion; cross-tenant recovery; sibling restart; onboarding recovery; identity substitution; stale-snapshot acceptance; duplicate relaunch; UNKNOWN late recovery; flag-default regression; migration/config/secret scope creep). NO CRITICAL, NO HIGH. ONE MEDIUM, raised independently by two reviewers: the first-draft monitoring gate used readiness_provider == PERSISTENT_WORKSPACE ONLY, which is STRICTLY NARROWER than the authoritative _build_contexts rule (provider==PW OR a workspace row exists) and would FALSE-NEGATIVE (not_monitored) an established monitoring account whose mutable readiness_provider lags while its terminal is down — latently re-opening the exact efficacy defect this packet fixes (fail-closed, DARK, so safe-but-ineffective). FIX APPLIED: the gate was moved before the ws-match gate (now 3b) and widened to the authoritative disjunction (provider==PW OR HostedMt5Workspace exists), matching _build_contexts exactly; the legacy-account test was corrected to a genuinely non-hosted account and a new mutation-killing regression test (test_provider_lag_with_workspace_present_is_still_eligible: workspace + READY endpoint + prior read present, provider lagging -> RC_ELIGIBLE) was added. A second independent verification pass (2 reviewers) CONFIRMED medium_resolved=true with zero new real findings: the disjunction matches the authority exactly, a genuine legacy account is still correctly excluded, and the reorder introduced no wrongful inclusion / ordering / import-cycle / N+1 defect. No other HIGH/CRITICAL finding surfaced.
limitations: PARTIAL (not PASS) because the feature stays DARK: both recovery flags remain default-OFF, the correction is NOT merged and NOT deployed, and the POSITIVE production acceptance (a deliberate terminal stop on a real established monitoring-only account) is a SEPARATE Sponsor-gated step — NOT run here. The monitoring-subject gate uses readiness_provider == PERSISTENT_WORKSPACE (fail-closed): an account whose durable provider marker lags a present workspace is conservatively not recovered until it resolves — never over-recovered.
